title: Dual frequency under a linear change of variables
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $M$ be an invertible linear map on $ br_2^n$, and let $b gamma,y\in\bbr_2^n$, where $\bbr_2$ is the field with two elements. Define the dual frequency $M^*\gamma$ by requiring its dot product with $y$ to equal the dot product of $\gamma$ with $M^{-1}y$. Then the dot product of the bent dual frequency of $\gamma$ with $y$ equals the dot product of $\gamma$ with $M^{-1}y$.
